name: Crab Fragment Labs (Cheapass Games)
bio: Crab Fragment Labs is the company of designer James Ernest, founder of Cheapass Games, the 1990s publisher of cheap games sold in envelopes without pawns or dice. The Cheapass catalogue was licensed to Greater Than Games from 2019 and returned to Crab Fragment Labs in 2025. Its shop offers print-and-play PDFs of the original games, from Kill Doctor Lucky to the Devil Bunny games, with an optional price and a free download link on every product page; this site links to those pages.
